authorizationPolicy.description: A payment record is only actionable when the acting session holds the capability that matches its lifecycle stage; approvals require payment:approve, operations require payment:operate, and read-only visibility requires signer.read. All identifiers, references, and remittance text are simulated and masked, and never carry raw banking details or PII.

maskingPolicy.description: Displayed references and remittance text are pre-masked demo-safe values. payment_reference uses a demo-post style prefix and beneficiary/debtor identifiers are masked; the UI must still apply the active masking context before rendering.

statuses.label: Pending approval
statuses.description: The payment has been submitted and is awaiting approval before release.

statuses.label: Accepted
statuses.description: The payment was approved and accepted for processing.

statuses.label: Processing
statuses.description: The payment is progressing through simulated compliance and settlement checks.

statuses.label: Pending review
statuses.description: A check raised a concern; the payment is held pending an operator decision.

statuses.label: Repair required
statuses.description: A correctable data issue was found; the payment must be repaired and resubmitted.

statuses.label: Sent to SWIFT
statuses.description: The payment message has been transmitted to the simulated SWIFT network and awaits acknowledgement.

statuses.label: Acknowledged
statuses.description: The simulated SWIFT network acknowledged the message and accepted it for onward delivery.

statuses.label: Rejected
statuses.description: A blocking check or acknowledgement failure rejected the payment. No funds were moved.
